assumptions: For the six added models only: one main 44-case observation per model, including original and technical-correction attempts with retained provider-reported usage; earlier disjoint qualification canaries are excluded. USD estimates use current official standard API tariffs checked on 2026-10-30, not invoices or verified historical billing. Cached reads and writes use their documented replacement rates; reasoning already included in output is not added twice. GPT-6.1 Terra uses the documented default 30-minute cache-write rate; no request selected another lifetime. Haiku, Mistral, Grok, GLM and Kimi have missing usage: displayed values cover recorded usage only and exclude unknown liabilities, reservation bounds and unverified fees. Provider-reported usage from failed attempts is included once, including Grok reports not admitted by the benchmark; Grok token estimates match returned provider cost ticks. River preview rates may change and separately unpublished fees remain unknown. Official sources: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-terra ; https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing ; https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing ; https://docs.x.ai/developers/cost-tracking ; https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-large-4-0.md ; https://console.river.ai/api/public/pricing ; https://docs.river.ai/guides/inference-models.md .
